cases.description: BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-depth-0: an unsplit token redeemed whole: depth 0, the part is the root
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-depth-1-part-40: root 100 split 40+60, the 40 part redeemed: root identity and lock amount 100, part amount 40
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-depth-1-part-60: root 100 split 40+60, the 60 part redeemed: root identity and lock amount 100, part amount 60
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-depth-1-part-40-real-proofs: root 100 split 40+60, the 40 part redeemed: root identity and lock amount 100, part amount 40
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-depth-1-part-60-real-proofs: root 100 split 40+60, the 60 part redeemed: root identity and lock amount 100, part amount 60
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-depth-2: a chain of 2 repeated splits: the deepest part redeems, the lock stays the root's
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-depth-3: a chain of 3 repeated splits: the deepest part redeems, the lock stays the root's
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-depth-8: a chain of 8 repeated splits: the deepest part redeems, the lock stays the root's
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-fanout-16: a split into 16 equal parts, one redeemed
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-fanout-256: a split into 256 equal parts, one redeemed
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-tree-understates-part: the tree commits 39 for the part that mints 40
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-tree-total-under: the tree totals 99 against a burned source of 100
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-tree-total-over: the tree totals 101 against a burned source of 100
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-changed-recipient: the proof was prepared for another recipient than the mint names
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-changed-salt: the child's salt changed after the commitment (a different token ID)
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-changed-amount: the child mints 41 against a commitment to 40
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-changed-type: the child's token type changed
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-changed-network: the child's network changed
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-changed-asset: the child's asset is another asset
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-lock-reason-on-a-part: a part claims the lock reason: its salt is not the lock's
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-unknown-reason: a part with a justification that is neither reason
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-proof-depth-changed: one proof step's depth changed
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-manifest-root-changed: the burn commits a manifest with another root
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-burn-predicate-not-manifest-hash: the parent burns to a predicate that is not the hash of its (valid) manifest
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-ancestor-certificate-outside-codec: an embedded ancestor certificate outside the native/SDK codec intersection (seal network 65536)
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-ancestor-signature-width: an embedded ancestor certificate whose seal signature has 63 bytes
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-not-a-manifest: the burn data is not a manifest
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-parent-return: the parent was returned: its burn carries a return reason, not a manifest
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-parent-not-burned: the parent ends in an ordinary transfer
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-parent-forged-unlock: the parent's last unlock signature is forged
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-parent-foreign-lock: the root names another vault
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-partial-part-return: the part returns 39 of its 40
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-return-more-than-part: the part returns the root's 100
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-repeated-token-id: a part with the root's own token ID: the root's mint state repeats
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-ancestor-leaf-unwitnessed: the root's mint leaf has no witness
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-witnesses-out-of-order: two ancestor witnesses swapped
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-seal-before-ancestor-times: every leaf is witnessed under a seal earlier than the lineage's reference times
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-neg-anchor-not-authenticated: the anchors are not in the admitted claim set
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V2 of lineage-refreshed-witnesses: the same part under fresh anchors: identical lock, part and nullifier
